findings.text: TWO_KEY_IMPACTS = {irreversible, money, external} deliberately EXCLUDES data_mutating, so a well-formed list impact=['data_mutating'] alone requires no second key. Matches spec AC4 (enumerates irreversible/money/external) and is documented, but two_key.py describes itself as gating 'irreversible OR data-mutating'. VEL-3 policy authors should confirm the surface intentionally does not two-key a data_mutating-only action. Not a fail-open vs this module's spec.

risk_acceptance free-text acceptance is permissive: any non-empty string _as_bool does not resolve to False passes (e.g. 'no' passes as free-text). Satisfies the round-1 requirement and the documented contract; tighten the free-text branch if the surface later wants a strictly-affirmative field.

Approver-registry lookup is exact-match (case/whitespace-sensitive) while separation/machine-actor normalize via _norm, so a registry-key mismatch fails closed as unknown_approver rather than reaching separation. Safe (fail-closed), but the W5 edge must supply attestation approver ids that match registry keys exactly, and the verified proposer must key on the same normalized identity.
